basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast from Cagayan de Oro, Philippines, with a penchant for bass-heavy music and urban exploration. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my love for travel and nature. I often find myself online late at night, unwinding with my favorite tunes and exploring the latest in audio technology. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to chase my passions without constraints. Dislikes include overly complicated tech jargon and any disruptions to my carefully curated playlists.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, which laid the foundation for my tech-savvy nature. Over the years, I've honed my skills through self-teaching and hands-on experience, particularly in audio technology and graphic design. My interest in headphones led me to explore various brands and models, making me somewhat of an aficionado in this niche.
